children: RBC Capital Markets says its outperform call on Suncorp runs counter to a consensus view that the general insurer's shares are fairly valued. RBC likes Suncorp's combination of earnings growth, share buybacks, strong balance sheet and capital optionality relative to IAG and QBE Insurance. "The centerpiece is capital returns," analyst Andrei Stadnik says. "We bake in A$900 million of buybacks across FY27-29 underpinned by a predictable earnings stream and the group's new five-year aggregate reinsurance cover." RBC starts coverage of Suncorp with a A$23.00/share price target. Suncorp is up 2.4% at A$20.96. RBC also starts QBE and IAG with sector perform calls. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
